description: Single storey rear extension, roof windows to first floor rear outrigger and associated alterations.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanBlock Plan 25014/525014/4G25014/225014/6Heritage StatementFlood Risk Assessment CFC25020 Rev BReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The proposed rooflights shall be flush with the roof plane. Prior to their installation, large-scale drawings of the proposed rooflights at a scale of between 1:1 and 1:20, including elevations and sections showing their relationship with the roof covering, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The rooflights shall thereafter be installed and retained in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance within the Bush Hill Park Conservation Area.
